scripts.speaker: Guild Clerk
scripts.text: The Emperium to be distributed to the guild office today has arrived. If you want to purchase, please put as many as you want~

scripts.speaker: Guild Clerk
scripts.text: It seems that many people are looking for Emperium today. It's just a personal feeling.

scripts.speaker: Guild Clerk
scripts.text: Our guild office actively supports the smooth gathering of adventurers.

scripts.speaker: Guild Clerk
scripts.text:
As part of that,
we are selling a limited quantity of 100 {0} every day
from ^0000ff18:00 to 23:59^000000 from ^0000ffMonday to Saturday^000000.

scripts.speaker: Guild Clerk
scripts.text: Please note that our guild office does not sell all the time because we have to run around to supply Emperium outside of the hours.
